Interface UserInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
ViewGUI, ViewTUI
public interface UserInterface
Defines the contract for the client-side user interface, abstracting over the TUI and GUI implementations. Methods in this interface are called by the Client in response to server notifications or local events, and are responsible for updating the display accordingly.

    • scrollPlayersPanel

      default void scrollPlayersPanel(int delta)
      Scrolls the players panel by the given number of rows. Positive delta scrolls down; negative scrolls up. The default implementation is a no-op for UIs that do not support scrolling.
      Parameters:
      delta - number of rows to scroll
